title: The Later Coastal Ferry
story: When the coastal coach broke down, passengers were asked to wait beside a petrol station with almost no shade. Andres had packed water, so he shared it with a child whose bottle was empty. The driver explained that a replacement coach would arrive within the hour, though the delay would make some people miss a ferry. Andres checked his ticket and saw that his own ferry was the later one. He offered his seat on the first replacement to a couple who were rushing. They thanked him twice. He reached the port after sunset, tired but calm, and still caught the boat he had booked.

vocabulary.definition: A cooler place out of direct sun.
Something sent to take the place of another.
A boat that carries passengers on a set route.
The time in the evening when the sun goes down.

quiz.question: Where were the passengers asked to wait?
options: Beside a petrol station with almost no shade
On the ferry they had already boarded
Inside a replacement coach that was already there
At the port before the coach had left
quiz.correctAnswer: Beside a petrol station with almost no shade
quiz.explanation: When the coach broke down, they were asked to wait beside a petrol station with almost no shade.
quiz.supportingSentence: When the coastal coach broke down, passengers were asked to wait beside a petrol station with almost no shade.

quiz.question: What does sharing his water suggest about Andres?
options: He drank the child's bottle and kept his own
He put a child's thirst ahead of keeping all the water
He had forgotten to pack anything to drink
The driver had banned drinks during the wait
quiz.correctAnswer: He put a child's thirst ahead of keeping all the water
quiz.explanation: He had packed water and shared it with a child whose bottle was empty, so he gave up some of his supply.
quiz.supportingSentence: Andres had packed water, so he shared it with a child whose bottle was empty.

quiz.question: What problem could the delay cause for some passengers?
options: They would have to push the broken coach
They would lose their seats at the petrol station
They might miss a ferry
They would have to walk back to the port at once
quiz.explanation: The driver said the delay would make some people miss a ferry.
quiz.supportingSentence: The driver explained that a replacement coach would arrive within the hour, though the delay would make some people miss a ferry.

quiz.question: What does the ending suggest about the seat Andres gave away?
options: Helping the couple still left him on the boat he had booked
He missed every boat and stayed at the petrol station
The child had taken his ticket during the wait
He arrived angry because the couple refused to move
quiz.correctAnswer: Helping the couple still left him on the boat he had booked
quiz.explanation: He reaches the port tired but calm and still catches the boat he booked, so the favour did not cost him the journey.
quiz.supportingSentence: He reached the port after sunset, tired but calm, and still caught the boat he had booked.

quiz.question: What does replacement mean in this story?
options: A ticket for a journey in another country
A seat that passengers are forbidden to use
A driver who will not explain the delay
A coach sent to take the place of the broken one
quiz.correctAnswer: A coach sent to take the place of the broken one
quiz.explanation: The replacement is the later coach that will stand in for the one that broke down.
quiz.supportingSentence: The driver explained that a replacement coach would arrive within the hour, though the delay would make some people miss a ferry.
